title: Host: secondary EL2->EL1 drop (roadmap S8): a PSCI-started core that enters at EL2 runs the boot loader's own phone-proven from_el2 sequence (HCR_EL2=RW, CNTHCTL_EL2=3, ICC_SRE_EL2|=9, CPTR_EL2=0, ELR/SPSR EL1h, eret) out of line at reset_vector, then continues XNU's EL1 path; NAT-195 probe kept as the fallback; reference scV otherwise
acceptance: The only EL2 writes are the loader's from_el2 values (test against shim/e1s-xnu/start.S on the patch and on the linked kernel)
No instruction outside the reset-vector page moves: segments and nm equal scV; loader sites rc 0
Package, counted session, analyser with registered verdicts for the native run (running count, per-core stage, faults, panic)
